items.title: Apple Issues Security Updates After Two WebKit Flaws Found Exploited in the Wild
items.description: Apple on Friday released security updates for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and its Safari web browser to address two security flaws that it said have been exploited in the wild, one of which is the same flaw that was patched by Google in Chrome earlier this week. The vulnerabilities are listed below - CVE-2025-43529 (CVSS score: N/A) - A use-after-free vulnerability in WebKit

items.title: Apple 0-Day Vulnerabilities Exploited in Sophisticated Attacks Targeting iPhone Users
items.description: Apple patches two WebKit zero-day flaws actively exploited in sophisticated attacks targeting specific iPhone users running iOS versions prior to 26.​ The iOS 26.2 and iPadOS 26.2 updates, released December 12, 2025, address CVE-2025-43529 and CVE-2025-14174 in WebKit. CVE-2025-43529 involves a use-after-free vulnerability enabling arbitrary code execution via malicious web content, discovered…
